entities.name: PurL FGAM synthase
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt A5GHL4 from Synechococcus sp. WH7803; length 765 aa.
Large PurL architecture contains FGAR-AT linker and duplicated AIRS/AIRS_C domain sets.
PurL is the ATP-dependent catalytic subunit of the three-part FGAM synthase complex; cytoplasmic and monomeric within a complex of 1 PurL, 1 PurQ, and 2 PurS subunits.
Catalytic activity is EC 6.3.5.3 with ATP and magnesium-ion binding annotations.

entities.name: FGAR to FGAM synthesis
observations: N(2)-formyl-N(1)-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)glycinamide + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O yields 2-formamido-N(1)-(5-O-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)acetamidine + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + H+.
PurQ generates ammonia from glutamine, while PurL uses the transferred ammonia to amidate FGAR in an ATP-dependent step.

entities.name: De novo purine biosynthesis
observations: PurL catalyzes the FGAR-to-FGAM step in de novo IMP biosynthesis.
